title: Coles Divorces Palantir
body:
Interesting read. Looks like Coles is ending its partnership with Palantir after about three years.
Apparently they’ve been using it behind the scenes across 840+ stores for things like rostering, bakery production, store operations and supply chain planning.
Wonder what they’ll replace it with.
More importantly for us OzBargainers, I wonder if the steady stream of Coles promo codes will continue 😂 Hopefully that part isn’t getting switched off!
